policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: Australia to create AI safety regulator after portal breach
items.summary: Australia accepted an inquiry’s recommendations after an O-related breach of a government portal, including possible criminal-law changes and steps toward stronger safety oversight. Adds compliance and operational risk.

items.headline: O: GPT-6 Cyber hits “critical” rating in cyber release
items.summary: O released GPT-6 Cyber to a subset of verified users, stating it reached its highest “critical” cybersecurity capability rating, and expanded its Daybreak program access. Potentially improves security tooling and enterprise adoption.

items.headline: V: Multiple reentry vehicles in orbit; more launches planned
items.summary: Space.com reported V operating two vehicles in orbit after Oct 1, 2026 launches (W-8/W-9) with another expected soon and additional launches into next year, reinforcing near-term capacity and manufacturing cadence.

items.headline: O: SoftBank executes final $10B follow-on tranche
items.summary: SoftBank disclosed execution of the third/final O follow-on tranche of $10.0B on Oct 1, 2026. Also notes cancellation of remaining $10B undrawn bridge capacity and repayment of borrowings—funding clarity.

items.headline: V: Series D $251M to scale space pharma processing
items.summary: V announced a $251M Series D, stating total capital raised of $598M and expansion of cadence plus deeper pharmaceutical partnerships. Also cited six reentry missions completed and more planned through 2028.

items.headline: V: Valuation cited at $1.6B in Series D reporting
items.summary: Reuters coverage (via StreetInsider) reported V raised $250M Series D at a $1.6B valuation while ramping microgravity pharmaceutical manufacturing. Supports valuation and financing momentum evidence.
